_comment: THIS FILE IS THE STARTING CHECKLIST. Edit it on GitHub and commit - the site redeploys and picks up the changes by itself, until the first edit is made inside the app (Checklists screen), after which the app owns them. Each building has a flat list of things to tick off - broad areas, not individual jobs. An entry is ["Name"], or ["Name", "Optional note"], and can take a third value: "photo" to allow a photo against it, or "photo required" to insist on one.
_everyVisit_note: Added to the bottom of EVERY building's checklist, on both a Full Clean and a Check.
everyVisit: Pick up any litter, inside and out
Replace anything that has run out
Deliver to Reception with a note of where it was found and the date
Report maintenance, damage, graffiti or missing items - include photos
Leave tidy and secure: lights off, rooms locked where applicable
_cleaningTypes_note: Every building has two checklists: "full" is the Full Clean, "check" is the quicker Check. Every building walks the same areas either way, so the two lists are the same and each area is stored once - the Check is the same round, done faster.
_buildings_note: Each building gets the areas listed here, plus "Every visit" at the end. An area is one tick; what is inside it is the note beside it. Seeonee lists its rooms separately so a cleaner doing only one room ticks only that room.
